title: The Lord's Prayer in 7 days
about: One line a day, with what the Fathers said about it.

days.title: Our Father, who art in heaven

items.text: The prayer the Lord Himself gave us. Each day, read the line and the Fathers on it: St Cyprian, St Cyril of Jerusalem, St John Chrysostom, Tertullian and others all wrote on the Lord's Prayer.
Tap a verse with a dot to read what the Fathers said about it.
